description: Inspect a domain backlink authority profile and generative AI citation graph across referring domains and authoritative web sources. Use this tool to evaluate Domain Rating, link velocity, anchor text diversity, and which URLs on a domain are most frequently cited by LLMs. Returns Domain Rating (0-100), referring domain counts, dofollow/nofollow ratios, spam risk score, anchor text distribution, and top AI-cited pages.

domain.description: Target root domain or hostname to analyze (e.g., "argosor.com").

include_anchor_distribution.description: When true, includes the categorized anchor text percentage breakdown (default: true).

include_llm_cited_pages.description: When true, includes the top URLs on the domain most frequently cited by Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Claude (default: true).

name: backlink_authority_graph
title: Backlink Authority & LLM Citation Graph
